name: @shiryakhat/pipeline
description: Offline content pipeline: corpus + website -> static content bundle consumed by the app

scripts.build: npm run episodes && npm run transcripts && npm run finalize
scripts.check:content: tsx src/finalize.ts && git diff --exit-code --stat -- ../content/glossary.json ../content/search-index.json ../content/index.generated.ts ../content/transcripts || (echo 'Derived content is stale: run `npm --prefix pipeline run finalize` and commit the result.' >&2; exit 1)
